user.title: Connect Tapo D235 Doorbell
user.description: Enter the doorbell's IP address and the TP-Link ID used in the Tapo app. The username is an email address.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the doorbell at this address. Check that Home Assistant and the doorbell are on the same network and that the IP address is correct.
error.invalid_auth: The doorbell rejected this TP-Link ID email address or password. Use the account that owns the doorbell in the Tapo app.
error.unsupported_device: This host is not a Tapo D235 doorbell.
error.unknown: Unexpected error; inspect the Home Assistant log.

init.title: Optional RTSP credentials
init.description: Only fill these in if RTSP is enabled and uses credentials different from the TP-Link ID used to connect the doorbell.
